component.name: HttpVideoScene
component.script: sub init() agent = CreateObject("roHttpAgent") agent.AddHeader("X-Emulator-Probe", "agent") m.top.setHttpAgent(agent) m.video = m.top.findNode("video") m.video.observeField("state", "stateChanged") m.timer = m.top.findNode("timer") m.timer.observeField("fire", "finish") content = CreateObject("roSGNode", "ContentNode") content.url = ReadAsciiFile("pkg:/base-url.txt") + "/media/playlist.m3u8" content.streamFormat = "hls" if ReadAsciiFile("pkg:/header-mode.txt") = "content" content.HttpHeaders = ["X-Emulator-Content: content"] end if m.video.content = content m.video.control = "play" end sub sub stateChanged() if m.video.state = "playing" and m.started <> true m.started = true print "playing" m.timer.control = "start" else if m.video.state = "error" print "error=";m.video.errorCode print "@@PROBE_END" end if end sub sub finish() m.video.control = "stop" print "@@PROBE_END" end sub
